channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: Walmart just extended its Christmas Eve delivery hours
item.description: Walmart just pushed its latest delivery window to 5 p.m. local time on Christmas Eve as retailers race to make shopping more convenient.

item.title: I went on a monthlong nomad cruise. The travel disappointed, but the community onboard didn't.
item.description: After 15 years as a digital nomad, Kaisu Koskela went on her first cruise. She found it both exciting and overwhelming.

item.title: Elon Musk says DOGE was 'a little bit' successful — but he wouldn't do it again
item.description: Elon Musk said he wouldn't participate in the DOGE office again, adding that it was only "somewhat" successful in saving taxpayer money.

item.title: AT&T CEO says he made a mistake in how he went about fixing company culture — but the viral memo wasn't it
item.description: AT&T CEO John Stankey said he was too slow on changing the company's culture, and that his viral employee memo was part of that process.

item.title: Trump defends tariffs as he launches economic tour: 'You can give up certain products. You could give up pencils.'
item.description: President Donald Trump is touring swing states to defend his tariffs and sell the message that the economy is booming.

item.title: Rivian's CEO said self-driving cars shouldn't just be able to drive, but also run errands for you like a secretary
item.description: CEO RJ Scaringe said he wants his AI-powered cars to be able to coordinate their own servicing, so their owners don't have to.

item.title: Ukraine's ground robots are surging in popularity, but have yet to carry out even 1% of its total drone missions
item.description: The battlefield is still dominated by aerial drones, which Syrski said are carrying out 60% of all strikes against Russian targets in the war.

item.title: Sequoia partners share how they decide which startups get a yes
item.description: Strong opinions on startups are far more important than agreement at Sequoia's investment decision meetings.

item.title: Rivian's CEO said there's a 'shocking lack of choice' for EV buyers in the US
item.description: Rivian CEO RJ Scaringe said EV adoption in the US was hampered by a "shocking lack of choice," compared to Europe or China.

item.title: Women at the top are exhausted and burned out, according to a McKinsey and Lean In report
item.description: Burnout among senior-level women is the highest it has been in the past five years, according to a report from McKinsey and LeanIn.org.
